Source: TODO.md

[x] Refactor ugc.R, sentiment-llm.R and nationalism.R to clearly distinguish the schema for each research question from the logic of applying it to the data; use test-driven development, setting up tests that mock the LLM output locally [x] Implement granularity/include_headline branching in load_aeolus()/tokenise_microtexts_by_sentence() (currently always sentence-tokenises with headlines retained) [x] Update run_pipeline_with_schema() to emit the results-CSV schema in docs/adr/0003-results-csv-schema.md (self-describing columns incl. research_question, raw model, context_variant, granularity, include_headline, microtext, unit_index, unit_of_analysis, label, score) [x] Build _targets.R + slurm-resources.yml (root-level, per ADR 0001), TDD-ing R/pipeline-grid.R/R/slurm-resources.R [x] Get rid of renv. It’s causing issues. Let’s just rely on the R package to run, and not worry about versioning. [x] Run the real-HPC smoke test (_test_targets.R via scripts/test-run.sh), before trusting the pipeline for a real sweep [x] Audit remaining env vars (e.g. OLLAMA_MODELS_DIR) against docs/environment-variables.md’s .env/~/.Renviron split; document any still missing [x] Rewrite scripts/run-sweep.sh so that it dispatches the job locally from laptop, using sapphire as the remote job dispathcing node, like scripts/test-run.sh [x] Add sync-results.sh (SSH-alias-based rsync wrapper to pull results/ down from the HPC cluster) [x] Update .gitignore to also ignore top-level results/ (only promoted copies under inst/extdata/results/ are tracked) [ ] Rewrite README.md to cover package usage (installation, basic example) alongside the HPC/SLURM workflow, with a high-level explanation for researchers/reviewers wanting to reproduce this analysis (see docs/environment-variables.md for the env-var setup split) [x] Manually promote one or more curated result CSVs into inst/extdata/results/ once a sweep has been reviewed (first run done) [ ] Turn the promoted-run metadata file (models.csv) into JSON with more keys (e.g. package version, timestamp, human-authored notes); update read_run_metadata() and ADR 0003 to match [ ] Guarantee run_id uniqueness in generate_run_id() (two runs in the same second with the same version currently collide) [x] Remove the central model store from the project (source field in models.yml/read_models(), resolve_ollama_models_dir()’s central branch, OLLAMA_CENTRAL_MODELS_DIR in .Renviron-hpc/docs/environment-variables.md, matching tests/docs); it caused bugs and is no longer used [ ] (Human) Rewrite RQ schema field descriptions, now that they are prompt text (ADR 0008): e.g. ugc_schema label is just “content type”; write “1” rather than “+1” everywhere; check wording against the rendered preview_prompt() output [x] Size sweep-dispatcher.slurm’s walltime (currently a 1440-min placeholder) against the real grid once a sweep’s actual wall-clock is known [ ] (Human) Pick replacement/additional models.yml candidates likely to run on llama.cpp (GGUF) rather than Ollama’s new engine, since only llama.cpp honours format/structured outputs (see mistral-medium-3.5:128b investigation). No capability flag exposes this — must probe empirically w/ scripts/structured-output-probe.R. Hints: classic single-modality architectures (llama, qwen2, gemma2, mistral (7B-ish, non-“3”/non-vision)) are more likely GGUF; newer/multimodal architectures (mistral3, gemma3n, anything branded “vision”/multimodal, or very new releases) are more likely on the new engine and risk silently dropping format. Check general.architecture via ollama show --json <model> / /api/show model_info before committing to a model. [x] Decide whether validate_results_schema() (R/schema-validation.R) should stay presence-only (current behavior) or also validate types/enum values (e.g. granularity %in% c("microtext","sentence"), include_headlines is logical) — now validates context_variant/granularity enums (fixed by ADR 0003) and include_headlines type; research_question/label/score left unchecked since valid values are per-schema (see new_rq_schema()), not fixed by the ADR [ ] Implement support for decision models once a newer version of Ollama is available on HPC [x] Finish proper implementation of rq-schema-type.R.
